**Products with no sales in the last 90 days (as of 2026-10-21): 17**

- P-0102, P-0117, P-0230, P-0231, P-0388
- P-0412, P-0415, P-0501, P-0577, P-0610

**Error from my price change last week (needs your decision):**

The catalog check flagged that my 3% increase on 2026-10-14 also hit 22 fixed-price contract products (P-1201 to P-1222). It was supposed to exclude them. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) have been placed at the increased prices, an overcharge of 4,128.60.

I have not changed any prices or orders. Proposed next steps:

1. Revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices.
2. Notify Lena Ortiz, since the overcharges affect customer invoices.
3. Have sales operations decide how to credit the 8 affected orders.

Shall I proceed with step 1 and send the note to Lena?
